description: This file is a shell script performing tests related to bounds-checking of access to mmapped on-disk file formats, particularly for Git pack and index files. It contains setup routines, test cases for handling corrupted or invalid pack and index files, and functions to manipulate and verify pack data.

methods.name: clear_base
methods.description: Removes the base pack directory and restores the environment to a clean state.

methods.name: restore_base
methods.description: Restores the base pack files from backup to the repository.

methods.name: do_pack
methods.description: Creates a pack file from given objects, with optional additional parameters, and sets up pack and index filenames.

methods.name: munge
methods.description: Modifies a pack or index file by injecting data at a specific offset.

methods.name: ofs_table
methods.description: Calculates the offset of the initial table in a v2 index file.

methods.name: extended_table
methods.description: Calculates the offset of the extended table in a v2 index file.
